point_causes.stream-not-folded: a session id is present in the run's own stream, so the pointer simply predates any observation that would record it
point_causes.harness-launch: the run is a task bound in the dispatching harness; it writes no backend stream, so no session id was ever captured for it
point_causes.stream-unreadable: cli launch whose recorded stream path is not a readable file, so capture had nothing to read
point_causes.stream-without-id: cli launch whose stream was read and carries no session id; the backend has not announced one for this run
